artifacts.title: Workflow Reference: The 5-Stage Synthetic Distillation Flywheel

claims: Automated synthetic distillation flywheels enable 3-week release cadences by eliminating human labeling bottlenecks
Deterministic programmatic verifiers act as external entropy anchors that prevent model collapse (The Curse of Recursion)
Rejection-Sampled Distillation (RSD) trains compact student models on verified teacher reasoning trajectories
Token de-noising compresses verbose teacher traces by 35% without degrading mathematical accuracy
Distilled dense models (e.g. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-32B) rival proprietary frontier teachers on competition math benchmarks
functions: Verification Filtering Mode Selector (Unfiltered to Verifier + Fluff Pruned)
Flywheel Recursion Rounds Slider (1 to 5 Generations)
observable_effects: Simulating multiple generations under Unfiltered mode triggers rapid model collapse and variance shrinkage
Enabling Deterministic Verifier mode arrests collapse and maintains high student accuracy across generations
Adjusting teacher-to-student scale demonstrates the trade-off between student parameter capacity and distillation fidelity

rules: Ground all distillation loss formulas in academic literature (Kim & Rush, Nature 2024, DeepSeek-R1)
Explicitly distinguish empirical facts from browser simulation models
Detail failure modes including mode collapse, synthetic bias amplification, and teacher capacity ceilings

objective: Provide an in-depth technical analysis and interactive ablation simulator of Synthetic Distillation Flywheels, demonstrating how verified teacher traces, automated filtering, and model collapse prevention power 3-week frontier release cycles.
audience: AI researchers, machine learning engineers, and system architects
